title: Polynomial-time abort-decision class
statement: The class is the union, over all natural numbers $c$, of the languages $L$ over the Boolean alphabet for which there exist a natural number $a$ and a finite nondeterministic Turing machine that abort-decides membership in $L$ within time $a(n^c+1)$ on inputs of length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a finite nondeterministic Turing machine
The machine abort-decides the language within the stated time bound
